  • 探討墨西哥實體小店將網路迷因商業化後，面臨版權歸屬與官方拒絕授權時的公關危機與處理智慧。
  • 解析遊戲官方在嚴格保護智慧財產權的同時，如何與社群創作者達成溫和溝通與「軟著陸」的平衡範例。

摘要

迷因爆紅與墨西哥玉米店的誕生

作者指出，在《勝利女神：妮姬》社群中，Dolla（Doro）迷因擁有極高的傳播度與代表性，甚至在官方收購前就已成為實質上的吉祥物。一對身為死忠玩家的墨西哥夫妻自2024年底起，將該形象融入自己的墨西哥玉米小吃店並販售周邊，迅速在拉丁美洲社群累積破萬追蹤。然而，這家小店繁榮發展的基礎，始終並非屬於他們自己的智慧財產權。

商標收購與商業授權遭拒的衝擊

2025年，遊戲開發商Shift Up向原作者購買專利並正式註冊商標，使原本處於灰色地帶的二創營利轉為具體的侵權風險。玉米店在同年9月嘗試與官方展開授權談判，儘管官方曾給予創作者獎項，最終仍拒絕了商業化授權請求。店家隨後發表聲明宣布停止使用該形象、刪除相關商業內容並展開新計畫，該告別貼文在社群引發超過200萬次瀏覽與激烈的正反論戰。

法理與人情的碰撞：社群反應與商業邏輯

部分玩家同情店家並批評官方無情，甚至臆測與前索尼高層的加入有關；但店家迅速澄清並未遭受施壓，理解正規企業的商業考量。另一方玩家與作者則認為，Shift Up履行法律義務是合理且必要的決策，避免未來因實體店品質問題反噬遊戲聲譽。相較於業界常見的跨海訴訟與高額索賠，官方既未開罰也未交惡，使這次事件成為一場和平收場的商業軟著陸。

保留共同記憶與迎向全新的原創品牌

隨著對話改善，官方允許店家保留帳號上的歷史影音作為社群回憶，店家也將檔案上傳供大眾進行非商業分享。重整旗鼓後，店家邀請全球玩家共同為全新吉祥物命名，並計畫在約一年後以更具獨立性與規模的品牌重新開業。作者認為，儘管這場版權風波迫使店家告別代表性招牌，卻也賦予其浴火重生、打造純粹自主品牌的全新契機。

================================================

The popularity and viral nature. of Dolla’s memes in recent years are. plain for all to see. This thing is. just too cute and infectious, even. spawning quite a few official and. fan-made items. Even before the. developers bought the rights, this pink. puppy had already become Nikke's. unofficial mascot, thriving in the. fan-art scene. Our main characters, the. owners of a Mexican corn shop, are a. prime example; since late 2024, they've. used Dolla's motifs to decorate their. store and create custom merchandise. The couple are not only huge Nikke fans. but also very active on social media,. quickly becoming a highly influential. account in the Latin American Nikke. community. Over the past two years, the. shop has flourished, with their cute.

Dolla merchandise and related events. helping them easily surpass ten. thousand followers. However, the. foundation of this shop's growth was. never their own intellectual property. In 2025, Shift Up purchased the patent. for Dolla from the original creator and. registered the trademark and appearance. . In other words, while using Dolla. unofficially for fun and clout was just. community memes, the legal landscape. changed once the trademark was bought; using it for commercial purposes now. carries a risk of infringement. Even as. food-related merchandise, it remains a. gray area of fan creation; if the shop. didn't get permission, it could be hit. hard at any time. The shop even posted. a carefully worded tweet on September. 21st of this year, stating they were in. negotiations with Shift Up to. officially license Dolla, which seemed. like a real possibility. Knowing Shift. Up, they had even sent them rewards for. the Nikke 2.5 th Anniversary Player.

Creator Award, but unfortunately, they. ultimately rejected their. commercialization request. They posted. on Twitter that they would stop using. Dolla in their business, create their. own new character, delete all. Dolla-related content, and embark on a. new path. The post quickly sparked a. huge uproar in the community with over. 2 million views, and global players. left over 700 comments on their. farewell post, showing widespread. outrage and even storming the official. social media accounts. Players are. divided into two camps. Some supporters. argue that since Lastor was founded in. 2024, how could the owner have known. then that they would be acquired by. SFUP? Furthermore, for a small snack. shop that has been open for over two. years, SFUP shouldn't make such a big. fuss over a shop far away in Mexico; it's quite heartless. Others believe. the real culprit is the former Sony. executive who joined SFUP, noting that.

they didn't care about this shop before. , but changed everything once that. executive arrived. Of course, this is. all speculation. The shop saw the. situation and quickly issued a. statement, saying they weren't. pressured by SFUP and that as a. legitimate company, they naturally have. their own business standards and. reasons. The shop expressed their. understanding. Another group of players. argued that, regardless of sentiment,. SFUP was just doing its legal duty,. even if they were a latecomer. This is. a somewhat ruthless but logically sound. business decision. You can't say that. just because this shop opened earlier. and made money before SU, it shouldn't. be targeted by SU. After all, we don't. know if the shop asked the original. creators for permission when they first. started profiting from it. It’s like. if there were unofficial fan-made. products everywhere, and someone opened. a popular physical store, decided to.

expand, and then went to the copyright. holders to try and legitimize it. It is. completely understandable why a company. would be unwilling to do this. Besides,. if such authorization were granted and. the shop caused any issues that harmed. the player community, the ultimate. pressure would fall back on SU. themselves. This outcome is reasonable; there's no way around it. Copyright. strikes are truly not uncommon in the. gaming industry. In the past, World of. Warcraft private servers often faced. copyright strikes, resulting in lawyers. , heavy fines, and matters being taken. to court when business interests. clashed. However, LStory is actually. quite lucky; the officials sent them. prizes and didn't impose fines, showing. their relationship isn't too bad—they. just couldn't reach a business. partnership. The shop can redesign its. image and might even gain more. popularity. It’s better than getting. dragged into painful legal proceedings.

over copyright disputes; this can be. considered a soft landing. On the 26th,. Or posted a new tweet, indicating that. the dialogue with SU has improved. significantly. Previously, they were. asked to stop using the content in. their business and delete related. materials, but now they have been. allowed to keep all previous posts and. videos on their accounts. These remain. for players to share memories and look. back on the good old days. They will. upload all media files to a folder for. everyone to download, so that these. elements can continue to be used and. shared for non-commercial purposes. They reiterated that they truly love. the game and are very grateful to SC. for allowing them to continue using the. related assets. Astor, appearing to. have regrouped on the 28th, invited. netizens from around the world to help. name their new mascot. After all, the. very idea of making it the shop's. mascot shows that the owner knows.

exactly how to connect with the player. community. Now that they are. redesigning the image, they have chosen. not to work in isolation, but instead. to leave this decision to the players. who have supported the shop all along. In the tweet, the owner also seemed. quite excited, discussing various. creative ideas with netizens while. looking forward to what this brand-new. image will ultimately look like. The. shop will now focus on its new identity. . However, it was revealed that the. store will likely reopen in about a. year. Astor seems very confident and. hopes that when they meet everyone. again, they will bring a larger, fully. independent shop of their own. They. also expressed their gratitude once. again to the players who have. accompanied the shop over these past. two years. At the end of the day,. although this incident forced the shop. to part with its most iconic sign, it. also gave them a chance to start fresh.

I hope that when the new shop opens,. Astor will still be able to make that. delicious Mexican corn—this time, it. must be perfect.

from merchants. It is worth noting that. Final Fantasy allows for two-player. co-op control during battles. However,. this feature is not mentioned in the. game's manual. You can. strategically set skills to achieve. twice the output with half the effort. during this state. the card game known as Tetra Master. Tetra Master was later spun. off into an online game, but that's a. story for another time. The other is. Chocobo Hot and Cold, where players can. dig for random treasures using maps. after reaching the Chocobo Forest. There are multiple digging spots across. the world, and by digging more often,. you can level up your Chocobo to find. even better treasures. Some ultimate. equipment in the game can only be. obtained through Chocobo treasure. hunting, which is a great help for. clearing the game smoothly. The game's. background music was entirely composed. by Nobuo Uematsu, reaching an. unprecedented 152 tracks, so much so. that the official 4-CD original. soundtrack only included 110, omitting. the music from the cutscenes. The. separately released PLUS CD later. supplemented this content. Uematsu. stated in an interview that the music. and the game itself were his favorites. among all his projects. The theme song. "Eyes on Me," sung by renowned singer. Faye Wong, has both Japanese and. English versions for different regions,. and all the music is now available on. Apple Music. After its release, the. game received widespread acclaim, with. Famitsu giving it a 38/40 Platinum Hall. of Fame rating and IGN a 9.2/10. primarily praised the game's nostalgic. elements, storytelling, and musical. score. Hironobu Sakaguchi considered. this game his favorite in the series. VIII was released on mobile, featuring. enhanced graphics and completely. redesigned menus, battle interfaces,. and dialogue windows. Players can. choose to skip animations, and there is. even a 2x speed mode to quicken the. pace; achievements and auto-save also. make it much more accessible for. newcomers. Building on this version, it. was subsequently released on a wide. range of platforms including Steam,. Switch, PS4, and Xbox One. Final. Fantasy VIII can be said to be a. perfect rebirth of the series' original. design philosophy on advanced hardware. Many ideas in the past were limited by. console performance and cartridge. capacity, but in the PS era, through. polygon technology and high-capacity. discs, the fantasy world in the. designers 'minds was finally realized. of old games, spread gaming culture,. and share in the ninth art. At the end. of the video, please like, follow, and. support us. Your support is our. motivation for updates. Thank you for. watching, and see you in the next one.

  • 深入了解以蜀漢為核心視角的戰棋遊戲如何透過「紅藍雙線」架構，同時演繹正史史詩與改寫悲劇的幻想可能。
  • 探索歷史戰役如何巧妙轉化為護送、誘敵、解謎等高深度戰術關卡，以及友善平民玩家的成長數值曲線。
  • 掌握經典單機戰棋的自由養成系統、多周目繼承機制，以及即將推出的北伐新劇情與限定獎勵內容。

摘要

重塑蜀漢史詩：紅藍雙線的浪漫與幻想

作者指出，三國歷史中蜀漢政權因劉備集團的浪漫理想主義與悲劇色彩，始終最受大眾矚目。基於《曹操傳》經典引擎由同人團隊打造的《蜀傳》，跳脫一般改編的框架，採用紅藍雙線劇情架構：歷史線完整呈現從桃園結義到三分天下的艱辛歷程，而幻想線則賦予玩家改寫命運的機會，探討如龐統倖存、法正長壽如何扭轉落鳳坡、荊州失守與夷陵之戰的走向。此外，劇本更深入刻畫了糜竺、馬雲祿等常被忽視的人物，展現出宏大且細膩的蜀漢群像。

融入歷史的關卡機制與深度策略養成

作者表示本作的戰場設計緊密契合劇情，將「千里走單騎」、「火燒博望坡」、「定軍山斬夏侯淵」等經典橋段轉化為護送、誘敵與地形解謎等多樣玩法。關卡設定嚴格的回合限制，講求策略破局而非單純數值壓制，難度適中且對無課金玩家相當友善。在養成方面，遊戲具備自由加點、果子培育、裝備合成與氣候地形等「五合一」多元機制，隨著周目繼承與爬塔挑戰，為玩家提供從艱難求生到以一當千的豐富回饋。

As everyone knows, whenever people. discuss the history of the Three. Kingdoms, the conversation regarding. the state of Shu is always the most. passionate. This is not only due to. heroes like the Five Tiger Generals or. geniuses like Zhuge Liang and Pang Tong. , but more importantly, under the. idealism of Liu Bei, the rise and. eventual fall of Shu-Han became a. tragic epic that left countless readers. longing for a different outcome. When. it comes to strategy games centered on. Shu-Han, everyone first thinks of Koei. Tecmo's "Romance of the Three Kingdoms" series. While that is certainly a. classic, as a tactical game, the. classic red-blue branching system from. Koei's "Cao Cao's Ambition" might. better capture the narrative potential. that makes the history of Shu-Han so. endlessly fascinating. Thus, a game. based on the "Cao Cao's Ambition" engine, fully focused on the turbulent. history of Shu-Han, was created by the. fan collective "Xinyue Huyu," known. simply as "Shu Zhuan." Wait. Anyone. with a slight understanding of the. Three Kingdoms knows that from folk. opera to classics like "Romance of the. Three Kingdoms," Shu-Han is almost. always the protagonist. But this also. means that the average player is.

already quite familiar with the. characters and plotlines of Shu-Han. In. this context, as a narrative-driven. tactical game, how can it achieve a. high standard and offer something truly. fresh in terms of its script? The. developer's primary answer is to build. upon the red-blue dual-line framework. of "Cao Cao's Ambition" to reinterpret. the various possibilities of the. Shu-Han story. Note that this dual-line. system is not a superficial. modification of the ending, but rather. two complete and comprehensive script. designs. The historical path follows. the familiar narrative of Liu Bei and. Zhuge Liang, centering on their three. generations of idealism, presenting the. arduous founding from the Oath of the. Peach Garden to the establishment of. the tripartite balance of power; the. fantasy path explores pivotal moments. to depict possibilities that change the. course of history. For instance, have. you ever imagined if Pang Tong survived. under your strategy, preventing his. death at Luofeng Slope, would Zhuge. Liang not needing to enter Sichuan be. able to rewrite the tragic fall of. Jingzhou? And if the genius strategist. Fa Zheng had lived longer, what. variables would he have brought to the. tragedy of the Battle of Yiling?

Coupled with all-new plot twists that. hit the right notes, an unexpectedly. captivating dream-like world, and even. more challenge modes to be added in. future updates, it is sure to deliver. an engaging experience worth replaying. again and again. Furthermore, within a. dual-path framework that is already. highly polished, the development team. has completely reimagined all the. characters associated with the Shu Han. faction. Whether it's historical. figures who were previously underserved. in such adaptations, original. characters like Ma Yunlu drawn from. folklore, or key supporting characters. like Mi Zhu who are often overlooked in. most works, everyone is given a. distinct personality and rich narrative. depth. The story does not limit itself. to the star power of the Five Tiger. Generals or the likes of Wolong and. Fengchu, instead portraying the. idealistic culture of the Shu Han. faction from a much more comprehensive. perspective. If there were to be a. selection of games featuring the Shu. Han faction as the protagonists with. top-tier writing, I believe the script. here would certainly be a strong. contender. Of course, as a game, the. most important thing is that it is fun. to play. First, building on an already.

excellent script, the level design. places great emphasis on the. integration of the battlefield and the. plot; historical events are not merely. background narrative, but actively. change the rules and objectives the. player faces. The game’s mission. types are diverse and colorful: from. escort missions like "Riding a Thousand. Li Alone" and "Protecting the People. Crossing the River," to tactical core. missions like "Burning Bo Wang" involving luring the enemy in, or. figuring out how to use Huang Zhong to. shoot down Xiahou Yuan at Dingjun. Mountain, and solving complex. environmental puzzles like the poison. traps in the Southern Campaign—all. these familiar stories are transformed. into playable mechanics, allowing. players a much deeper sense of. immersion in the plot. It is worth. noting that to highlight the hardships. of the Shu Han faction’s humble. beginnings, the game’s challenge. level is not easy. Many mission types. cannot be won by brute force alone; they require strategy, and most have. turn limits, meaning many stages have. more than one solution and rarely allow. for one-sided dominance. Instead of. just overwhelming enemies with high. stats, players must think carefully to.

find the right solution, which makes. the difficulty level feel quite. reasonable and player-friendly. On the. Normal difficulty, even without. spending money, the resources collected. through stage secrets, daily check-ins,. and other methods are more than enough. to clear the game smoothly. From a. single-player game design perspective,. the growth curve in "Sheng San" provides clear feedback. The first. playthrough is a strategic challenge. focused on survival, while from the. second playthrough on, players can. experiment with equipment synthesis and. stat-boosting fruit cultivation,. shifting from a difficult struggle to. an experience of taking on thousands. single-handedly. Coupled with long-term. challenges like the tower-climbing. system, cross-save inheritance modes,. and achievement-based side quests,. players are guaranteed a high-quality. single-player experience that remains. fresh across multiple playthroughs. In. terms of development, general training. uses a dual-track mechanism balancing. raw stats and growth potential. Since. attribute points can be freely. allocated, it directly affects the. unit's growth. Combined with a. five-in-one attribute system—. encompassing skills, sets, terrain,.

strategy, and unit types—as well as. dynamic weather changes, the game's. mechanics are incredibly diverse,. offering a scope for strategic. decision-making that far exceeds many. similar titles. Although it includes. online updates and login rewards, " Sheng" is essentially a traditional. single-player strategy game at its core. . Players feel none of the pressure. found in typical mobile games; there. are no daily tasks to complete and no. need to compete with others, so there. is no need to worry if you can't log in. for a while. Players can pause and save. their progress at any time, playing. entirely at their own pace. You can. spend an entire evening pondering a. single level to find the solution,. stepping into your own Three Kingdoms. battlefield anytime, anywhere, and. experiencing this heroic epic however. you like. It’s also worth mentioning. that this National Day holiday will. bring a major update, extending the. main storyline from the escape from. Baidicheng to the first Northern. Expedition, alongside the official. debut of the new legendary general, Cai. Wenji.
